tools.title: Tools
tools.scope.label: Scope
tools.scope.globalHint: Only what is installed on your computer (applies to every project)
tools.scope.repoHint: What your AIs see in this repository: global plus what the project brings
tools.scope.repoNeedsWs: Open a workspace to see the repository scope
tools.empty: No skills, commands, plugins or MCPs found in your AI folders.
tools.weightHint: Approximate size of the main file in the AI context
tools.m.settingsSub: Skills, commands, plugins and MCPs of your AIs
tools.health.allGood: All good: no broken links, duplicated or diverging copies.
tools.roots.title: Folders and files read
tools.roots.envHint: Environment variable that moved this folder
tools.detail.gone: This item is no longer on disk.
tools.detail.notePh: What you use it for, when to remember it…
tools.source.title: Where it came from
tools.how.auto: the AI picks it from the description
tools.state.managed: managed by the AI or a plugin
tools.finding.brokenLink.title: {name}: broken link at {path}
tools.finding.brokenLink.why: The AI can't find it: the link points to {target}, which no longer exists.
tools.finding.drift.title: {name}: {copies} copies with different content
tools.finding.drift.why: Each AI uses a different version. Linking to a single version avoids different behavior.
tools.finding.duplicateCopy.title: {name}: {copies} identical copies
tools.finding.duplicateCopy.why: Loose copies don't update together. A link to the shared folder (.agents) keeps one version.
tools.finding.orphan.title: {name} is only in the shared folder (.agents)
tools.finding.orphan.why: No AI links to it: only AIs that read ~/.agents directly can see it.
tools.finding.nameConflict.title: {name}: same name from different sources ({sources})
tools.finding.nameConflict.why: One may override the other, depending on the order each AI reads its folders.
tools.finding.stalePluginVersion.title: {plugin}: {count} old versions in the cache
tools.finding.stalePluginVersion.why: Leftovers from updates taking up space; the version in use doesn't change.
tools.finding.unrecognized.title: Unrecognized format: {path}
tools.finding.unrecognized.why: This Kabul version can't read it ({detail}); the rest of the screen is still valid.
tools.finding.parseError.title: Couldn't read {path}
tools.finding.parseError.why: What is in this file may be missing here (and may not work in the AI). Detail: {detail}
tools.finding.missingDescription.title: {name} has no description
tools.finding.missingDescription.why: AIs pick skills by their description; without one, the skill is rarely used on its own.
tools.finding.heavy.title: {name} is heavy (~{tokens} tokens)
tools.finding.heavy.why: It takes a large part of the context whenever it loads.
tools.finding.nestedRepo.why: Repositories inside repositories often bring their own skills and settings that mix with the project's.
tools.finding.placeholder.title: {name}: configuration with a placeholder value
tools.finding.placeholder.why: A value is still a placeholder (YOUR_…_HERE): the server will fail until it is filled in.
tools.finding.hookRunsCode.title: {name} runs a command on {events}
tools.finding.hookRunsCode.why: Hooks run programs on your computer at every event; make sure you recognize where it came from.
tools.finding.unpinnedMcp.title: {name} runs without a pinned version ({target})
tools.finding.unpinnedMcp.why: npx -y and @latest download the newest version at every start: behavior can change without notice.
tools.finding.registryMissing.title: {name}: recorded at install, but not on disk
tools.finding.registryMissing.why: The install record points to something that no longer exists; reinstalling from the source fixes it.
tools.finding.registryEdited.why: An update from the source may overwrite these changes.
tools.finding.stackedInstall.title: {name} is installed twice (plugin and manual copy)
tools.finding.stackedInstall.why: The AI may load both versions; keep only one to avoid duplicates.
